concern: Urdu مثل (misl, "like/similar to") is romanised "Misal", which reads as مثال (misal/example) -- same confusion as 8:52 and 8:54. The corpus's other occurrences of مثل all use "misl".
suggestion: Misl un logon ke jo tum se pehle the, tum mein se woh zyada quwwat wale the aur zyada maal-o-aulaad wale the, pas woh apna deeni hissa barat gaye, phir tum ne bhi apna hissa barat liya jaise tum se pehle ke log apne hisse se faida-mand hue the aur tum ne bhi isi tarah mazaaqana behas ki jaise ke unhon ne ki thi. Un ke aamaal dunya aur aakhirat mein ghaarat ho gaye. Yahi log nuqsaan paane wale hain.

suggestion: Aur teen shakhson ke haal par bhi jin ka mamla multawi chhod diya gaya tha.
